description: This file defines a PHP controller class for managing subscription plans within the OpenCart admin catalog module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting subscription plans, along with handling form submissions, pagination, sorting, and breadcrumbs.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Controller class for handling subscription plan CRUD operations in the admin catalog area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the subscription plan listing page, initializes the page with language, title, breadcrumbs, and calls getList.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of subscription plans, including setting pagination, sorting, and filtering, then rendering the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares subscription plan data, handles sorting, pagination, and generates the view for the list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a subscription plan, populating data from the model if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or update a subscription plan.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected subscription plans.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or update a subscription plan, including permission checks, validation, and JSON response.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies selected subscription plans, performs permission check, and returns JSON success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription plans after permission validation and returns JSON response.
